rideloop.description: Ride request, driver location, and dispatch microservices with geohash-indexed DynamoDB positions, PostgreSQL trips, and a React rider map

modelgate.description: PyTorch ETA model serving in FastAPI with input validation, shadow runs of new versions, Prometheus metrics, and zero-drop version swaps

dispatchgrid.description: Rider request, driver location, and matching services in Java with Kafka Streams, city-sharded MySQL, Redis geospatial lookup, and Kubernetes rolling updates

failsafe.description: Resilient Python API gateway with token-bucket rate limiting, circuit breakers, retries with backoff, Prometheus metrics, and Kubernetes chaos-tested failover

launchbridge.description: FastAPI integration service with signed webhooks, PostgreSQL deduplication, bounded retries, failed-event replay, Docker builds, and an AWS deployment with smoke tests

playbook.description: Expert SOP to deployed agent: ingests a walkthrough and SOP into a tool-calling agent with Jira and Slack tools, grades runs against expert rubrics, feeds corrections back into its prompts, deployed on AWS with Terraform

panelist.description: Expert grading and data delivery platform: expertise-tag task routing, attention checks, per-task payouts, and rubric scores in PostgreSQL, served by FastAPI on AWS ECS

ledgermesh.description: Three fault-tolerant Spring Boot microservices on Docker with Kafka messaging, Redis caching, Resilience4j circuit breakers and timeouts, GitLab CI, and chaos tests with zero failed orders

tradegraph.description: Counterparty knowledge graph in Stardog from SEC filings: Python ETL, Spring Boot SPARQL APIs with lineage and exposure queries, Angular explorer

spoofline.description: Two-stream audio and video spoof detection with per-stream calibration and score fusion

expertloop.description: Turns expert task notes into agent instructions with linked sources, tracks edits and approval state in PostgreSQL, and gates approved workflows behind test cases before they reach business systems

conduit.description: Reusable integration connector kit: one adapter interface for Slack, Jira, and webhooks with idempotency keys, backoff retries, an SQS dead-letter queue, and Terraform so a new integration ships from one config file

kernelcheck.description: CUDA C++ kernels with a CPU execution model that runs the same sources without a GPU

rankfault.description: Fault injection harness for multi-rank PyTorch distributed jobs: rank kills, freezes, link delays and cuts, and collective ordering skew injected while collectives are in flight, each run classified by a pre-registered outcome classifier. Measured on gloo (CPU).
